# Turing-RK1 hardware matrix

Maintainers have this board, so functions can be verified on hardware.

*Profile* is the profile that provides the function: `free`, `full` (needs non-free artifacts) or `blocked`. See [Free vs non-free](Turing-RK1-Free-vs-NonFree).

| Function | Status | Profile | Features | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bmc-console | implemented-unverified | free | turing-rk1-core |  |
| boot | implemented-unverified | free | turing-rk1-image |  |
| emmc | implemented-unverified | free | turing-rk1-image |  |
| ethernet | implemented-unverified | free | turing-rk1-core |  |
| nvme | implemented-unverified | free | turing-rk1-core |  |
